title: Rajasthan PTET Admit Card 2026
fullContentHtml:
Short Information : Vardhman Mahaveer Open University, MVOU Kota has released the admit card for the Rajasthan 2 Year B.Ed. Joint Entrance Examination 2026. Applications for the Rajasthan PTET Admission Online Form 2026 were accepted from 20 February 2026, to 20 March 2026. The entrance examination is going to be conducted on 14 June 2026. Candidates who had applied this form can download their Rajasthan PTET Admit Card 2026 from the link given below.

Vardhman Mahaveer Open University, MVOU Kota

Rajasthan PTET Admit Card 2026

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 20 February 2026
  • Last Date : 20 March 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 20 March 2026
  • Exam Date : 14 June 2025
  • Admit Card Available : 08 June 2026

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 500/- 
  • SC, ST : Rs. 500/- 
  • Pay the Examination Fee Through Debit Card, Credit Card, Net Banking, E Challan, E Wallet, Cash Card Fee Mode Only.

Rajasthan PTET Entrance Exam 2026 : Course Details

Course  Course Name
Pre Teacher Education Test 02 years

Rajasthan PTET Online Form 2026 : Educational Qualification

  • Candidates must have at least 50% marks in aggregate in the Bachelor’s / Master’s Degree examination of any State University or any other University recognized as equivalent to and fulfilling the other requirements for admission to B.Ed. course. However, Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, Other Backward Classes, MBC as well as physically challenged and Widow or Divorced women candidates of Rajasthan having at least 45% marks in aggregate in the Bachelor’s or Master’s degree level examination.
  • Candidates who have passed Graduation through Correspondence Course from any University by taking only one University Examination (One/Single sitting), even if they have cleared PG degree on the basis of this degree, are not eligible to appear in PTET; candidates who have not studied through 10+2+3 scheme or 10+1+3 (old scheme) are also not eligible to appear in PTET.
  • Candidates who are appearing in the qualifying examination i.e. B.A. / B.Com. / B.Sc. / Shastri Final year and / or M.A./ M.Com. / M.Sc / Acharya Final year may also apply and appear in the PTET 2026.

How To Download Rajasthan PTET Admit Card 2026

  • In order to download their Rajasthan PTET Admit Card candidates are required to go to the important link section provided below.
  • After getting the link candidates need to click it for downloading their Rajasthan PTET Admit Card.
  • Candidates need to provide their following details-:
  • Registration No. /Roll No.
  • DOB/Password
  • Captcha Code(if specified)
  • After providing their details appropriately candidates will be able to check their Rajasthan PTET Admit Card.
  • Candidates can also check their Rajasthan PTET Admit Card from official site of the MVOU.

Rajasthan PTET Application Form 2026 : Mode of Selection

  • Mental Ability
  • Teaching attitude & Aptitude Test
  • General Awareness and
  • Language Proficiency (Hindi or English)
